pages.title: Nitro Speed 2 Underground
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Race sports cars through a night city in Nitro Speed 2 Underground. Use nitro when the road opens up and try the different modes as you work through the driving challenges.

pages.title: World Wars - Tanks
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Choose a World War II faction in World Wars - Tanks. Take its armored vehicles into tactical battles and consider how the different machines handle terrain and enemy fire.

pages.title: Scoop Tower
pages.creator: Sau Infotech
pages.description: Stack ice cream scoops in Scoop Tower. Drop each one when it lines up above the pile and watch for gusts that affect balance. Perfect drops help trigger Fever Mode.

pages.title: Single Line: Drawing Puzzle
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Draw each shape in a single continuous stroke in Single Line: Drawing Puzzle. Work out where to start so you can trace every part without lifting or retracing the line.

pages.title: 67 Clicker Tap Tap
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Tap for 67 Points in 67 Clicker Tap Tap. Spend the points on upgrades to increase what you earn, then work toward unlocking more of the meme characters.

pages.title: Hidden Objects: Island Secrets
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Recover objects scattered through time in Hidden Objects: Island Secrets. Search the scenes for what the crystal displaced and piece together the island's mystery as you find the items.

pages.title: The Roman Empire Colosseum
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Set a formation in The Roman Empire Colosseum and send your army into the arena. Position units such as riders, warriors, and mages before watching the battle play out.

pages.title: Anomaly Content Record
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Investigate a research facility that went silent in Anomaly Content Record. Explore as a field investigator, watching for what might be waiting inside as you look for a way to escape.

pages.title: Tile Hexa Sort
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Organize hexagonal tiles by color in Tile Hexa Sort. Group identical pieces into stacks and keep an eye on spare space as later boards introduce more colors.

pages.title: Obby Modes! Online Mini-Games
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Try three challenges in Obby Modes! Online Mini-Games. Climb an obstacle course, take on a five-player race, or pick your way across a glass bridge. Customize your character with skins.

pages.title: StickMan Gunner
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Guide a moving gun in StickMan Gunner. Pick up stickmen along the route to build your crew, then use that firepower to get through enemies and obstacles.

pages.title: Hunt And Seek
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Search for hidden characters in Hunt And Seek. Take on the puzzles and pay attention to the randomly selected arrester when the next round begins.

pages.title: Block Digger
pages.creator: Skilli
pages.description: Tap to break stones in Block Digger and collect coins and crystals. Use what you earn to improve your mine and open up new locations for digging.

pages.title: Noob Draw Punch
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Sketch the path of a punch in Noob Draw Punch. Guide the fist around whatever blocks your shot and land it on the monsters threatening the rookie.

pages.title: Offroad Island
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Take different vehicles across rough terrain in Offroad Island. Complete missions for cash and spend it on upgrades, then try the improved vehicle on another map.

pages.title: Demolition Car - Rope and Hook
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Aim a hook in Demolition Car - Rope and Hook and attach the rope to a structure. Pull with the vehicle and try different attachment points to see how the building comes down.

pages.title: Gun Fest
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Pick doors that help your weapons in Gun Fest. Steer the moving lineup around obstacles and use its firepower against enemies as you try to reach the end.

pages.title: Dusty Maze Hunter
pages.creator: GATE04
pages.description: Work through labyrinth rooms in Dusty Maze Hunter. Plan which path to take around the obstacles, and use what you learn from each layout to solve the next.

pages.title: Arsenal Online
pages.creator: Wilkin Games
pages.description: Choose a shooting challenge in Arsenal Online. Go for accuracy in Sniper or take out as many targets as possible in Time Attack. Play solo or with a friend and unlock gear.

pages.title: Chop and Crush: Mining clicker
pages.creator: Barsuk Studio
pages.description: Gather resources on an island in Chop and Crush: Mining clicker. Tap to chop trees and break rocks, then buy tools such as pickaxes, axes, and chainsaws.

pages.title: BFF Math Class
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Get ready for class in BFF Math Class. Pack the student's bag and choose a hairstyle, outfit, and accessories for her to wear to school.

pages.title: Bullet Time Agent
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Steer a shot after firing in Bullet Time Agent. Guide the bullet around obstacles and correct its path so it reaches the intended target.

pages.title: Free Birds
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Shoot the ropes holding birdcages in Free Birds. Look for a clear line past the obstacles and use accurate shots to release the birds in each setup.

pages.title: Mini Swim
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Swim through underwater hazards in Mini Swim and gather the treasure in each stage. Use the arrows or WASD to steer, or try collecting coins in speedrun mode.

pages.title: ColorPoly
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Rotate a square in ColorPoly so the right face meets each falling bar. Tap to change its orientation and watch the incoming color before the two touch.

pages.title: Raid Heroes: Sword and Magic
pages.creator: PERSONA•GAMES
pages.description: Gather a squad in Raid Heroes: Sword and Magic to fight the Dark Lord's forces. Upgrade artifacts and weapons, then choose heroes to face enemies such as goblins and warlocks.

pages.title: Rubek
pages.creator: Xigma Games
pages.description: Roll a cube across colored squares in Rubek. Pick up colors and use them to match the floor as you plan a route to the goal. Collect stars along the way.

pages.title: GardenEscape
pages.creator: BestGamesDevelopers
pages.description: Help a dog escape an enchanted island in GardenEscape. Make groups of matching pieces and use power-ups when you need help clearing the puzzle in front of you.

pages.title: shape matching
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Join the dots from left to right in shape matching. Use the mouse or touchscreen to complete the shapes as you work through twenty levels.

pages.title: Bubble Pet Saga
pages.creator: BestGamesDevelopers
pages.description: Shoot at matching pet bubbles in Bubble Pet Saga. Make groups of at least three to clear them, then find angles that help you finish each of the twenty-five layouts.

pages.title: Kings of Blow
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Blow the contents of a tube toward your opponent in Kings of Blow. Decide when to inhale and when to exhale to keep the object moving away from you.

pages.title: Police Car Cop Real Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Drive a patrol car through the city in Police Car Cop Real Simulator. Chase car thieves and deal with reckless drivers while following the routes your assignments give you.

pages.title: March Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Color spring animals and flowers in March Coloring Book. Click or tap to add your own colors to the pictures celebrating the first month of spring.

pages.title: Effing Worms 2
pages.creator: Effing Games Inc.
pages.description: Burrow and feed in Effing Worms 2. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move the hungry worm, then watch it grow and evolve as you eat.

pages.title: Mortal Brothers Survival
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Work together as Scorpion and Subzero in Mortal Brothers Survival. Collect the flames that belong to each character and solve the dungeon puzzles so both can escape.

pages.title: Funny Puppy Emergency
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help puppies recover in Funny Puppy Emergency. Use the mouse to handle the veterinary tasks and treat each problem. Pick an outfit for the puppy after treatment.

pages.title: Death Lab
pages.creator: Bubblebox
pages.description: Use ricochets, grenades, and Tesla rays in Death Lab. Work out how to clear every enemy in each layout and try the new skills you unlock along the way.

pages.title: Minigolf Tour
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Pick a tour in Minigolf Tour and compete over three tracks. Aim to finish each hole in few strokes, then use coins and gems to open collectible chests.

pages.title: orbit
pages.creator: nau.studio
pages.description: Time your shots to hit moving targets in orbit. Watch the path of each target and act when it lines up. The timing becomes more demanding as you advance.

pages.title: Bamboo Run
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Collect bamboo to build height in Bamboo Run. Use a swipe or the mouse to steer toward stalks and build a tall enough stack to reach the destination.

pages.title: Fishing 2 Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Slide pins to save the character in Fishing 2 Online. Think through what the pins are holding back and release them in an order that keeps the little fish safe.

pages.title: Ring Of Love 3D
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Guide a ring along the course in Ring Of Love 3D. Look at what blocks each stretch and steer around the obstacles until you reach the finish.

pages.title: Conduct THIS!
pages.creator: Northplay
pages.description: Manage a railway in Conduct THIS! Switch tracks and control trains so passengers get to their stops before time expires. Watch intersecting routes and prevent the trains from colliding.

pages.title: Monster Truck Extreme Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race or practice stunts in Monster Truck Extreme Racing. Finish in the top three for race prizes or earn rewards in Free Drive, then use them to modify the trucks.

pages.title: Dirt Bike Rally
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Take a dirt bike through the races in Dirt Bike Rally. Steer with WASD or the arrows and look ahead for obstacles as you try to get past the other riders.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Wheel
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shoot matching colors onto a rotating wheel in Bubble Shooter Wheel. Clear groups of at least three, and work quickly because your point total decreases while you play.

pages.title: Christmas Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Chain matching holiday items in Christmas Collection. Connect at least three neighbors in any direction, including diagonally, and look for longer chains when you need extra time.

pages.title: Piggy In The Puddle Christmas
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Get the pig to a mud bath in Piggy In The Puddle Christmas. Change its shape to roll or stop, and use other animals to remove obstacles and collect acorns.

pages.title: What is
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Choose the object that fits the prompt in What is. Look through the available pictures and click the one that corresponds to what the game asks for.

pages.title: Pocket Sniper
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Carry out assignments in Pocket Sniper with a limited supply of ammunition. Check who's in view before you shoot and complete the objective while keeping bystanders out of harm's way.

pages.title: Cat Shot
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Launch a kitten from a slingshot in Cat Shot. Use the dotted guide to judge the trajectory and aim where it will collect the items in each setup.

pages.title: Funny Zombies Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find matching zombie illustrations in Funny Zombies Memory. Turn over two tiles, remember what you saw, and clear each of the four levels in as few moves as possible.

pages.title: Bike Ride Parking Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Ride and park different vehicles in Bike Ride Parking Game, from police motorcycles to quad bikes. Give each bike enough room to turn as you approach the assigned parking spot.

pages.title: SnakeZ
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Grow in SnakeZ by eating what you find and cutting off rival snakes. Use space to boost, then pick up what a rival drops after colliding.

pages.title: Commando
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Clear fifteen combat stages in Commando. Use the mouse to aim and fire, move with WASD or the arrows, and throw a grenade with G when you need it.

pages.title: London Crime City
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Follow assignments around London in London Crime City while evading police. Take different vehicles through the city and explore the map for hidden equipment as you unlock more weapons.

pages.title: Funny Balloons
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Pop every rising balloon except the red ones in Funny Balloons. Click or tap before they float away and try to improve your score without hitting the wrong color.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Valentines
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shoot heart balloons in Bubble Shooter Valentines. Group matching colors before the cluster reaches you, and use power-ups to get out of difficult layouts.

pages.title: Smack Domino
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Start a domino chain in Smack Domino. Aim a ball at the right tile and check how the first hit carries through the arrangement. Knock everything down to finish.

pages.title: Spooky Jungle Safari
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Drive into a reportedly haunted jungle in Spooky Jungle Safari. Use WASD or the arrows as Jamie follows his curiosity, despite Aron's warning to stay away.

pages.title: Mini Fighters : Quest & battle
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Lead a small army in Mini Fighters : Quest & battle. Use each soldier's strengths and weapons and decide how to balance attacks, defense, and special abilities.

pages.title: Rock Music
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Play along with the beat in Rock Music. Use A, S, K, and L or tap the colored controls when the notes arrive, then try to keep a scoring streak going.

pages.title: Knife Hit Up
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Leap between pieces of fruit in Knife Hit Up. Time the little monster's jumps so it can reach the next piece and keep going for a better score.

pages.title: Tomb Of The Mask Color
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Paint every passage in Tomb Of The Mask Color. Steer through the mazes, checking where obstacles are moving before crossing their path. Finish one layout to move to the next.

pages.title: Traffic.io
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Start and stop vehicles to avoid collisions in Traffic.io. Click a car before it enters a busy crossing, then let it go when there is room.

pages.title: Cube Shift
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Slide to change the shape of the cube in Cube Shift. Look at the opening ahead and give the cube the dimensions it needs before it reaches the obstacle.

pages.title: Bricks Jenga 3D
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Remove one block per turn in Bricks Jenga 3D and set it on top of the tower. Choose a loose piece and watch how the stack shifts as you pull.

pages.title: MineCoin Adventure
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Get a coin to the marked area in MineCoin Adventure. Click or tap to cut the rope and consider how the coin will fall onto the platform.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Barcelona
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Assemble sixteen scenes of Barcelona in Jigsaw Puzzle Barcelona. Drag pieces into place and use the eye button to see the full image when you need a reference.

pages.title: Halloween Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Line up matching pets in Halloween Match 3. Make rows or columns of at least three and clear the dirty squares before time runs out.

pages.title: Spike Jump
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Tap to jump over spikes in Spike Jump. Look ahead before committing to each leap, and collect money to spend on other skins for later runs.

pages.title: Picker 3D
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Sweep pieces off the road in Picker 3D. Steer the collector toward groups of objects and gather enough to meet the level's goal before moving on.

pages.title: Car Wash & Gas Station Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drive, refuel, and wash the car in Car Wash & Gas Station Simulator. Follow the route for each job and bring the vehicle to its assigned parking area.

pages.title: Line Color
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Color a route in Line Color by moving past obstacles. Time your progress at each hazard and try to reach the checkpoint without making contact.

pages.title: Luxury Medium SUV Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of midsize SUVs in Luxury Medium SUV Puzzle. Pick one of six images and choose a piece count, then match details of the vehicles and backgrounds.

pages.title: Mad Shark
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Swim and shoot in Mad Shark. Use the up and down arrows to move and Shift to fire. Pick up lives and upgrades while avoiding mines, missiles, and barrels.

pages.title: EG Casino Memory
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Turn over casino cards in EG Casino Memory. Remember which picture appeared in each spot, and match every identical pair before the timer ends.

pages.title: Tap the zombies
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Tap or click the incoming undead in Tap the zombies. Focus on those nearest the edge of the area, since you need to finish the level without letting any through.

pages.title: Kung Fu Street 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Take on street fighters in Kung Fu Street 2. Use the arrow keys and V to control your fighter and react as enemies move into striking range.

pages.title: Stickman Run
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Jump with space or the mouse in Stickman Run. Time the jumps to get past the obstacles and see how far you can keep the endless run going.

pages.title: Bff Fantastical Summer Style
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get Emma, Mia, Bella, and Audrey ready for a holiday party in Bff Fantastical Summer Style. Pick makeup and outfits after the four friends spend time in the pool.

pages.title: Tower Defense 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Build defenses against waves in Tower Defense 2D. Choose towers for the enemies coming down the route and use spells or special abilities when a wave needs more attention.

pages.title: Offroad Truck
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Deliver goods along rough routes in Offroad Truck. Keep the cargo safe as you drive, and spend the money from each job on truck upgrades or new levels.

pages.title: Color Snake
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Break barriers that match the snake's color in Color Snake. Look ahead for blocks of other colors and steer around them to keep the run going.

pages.title: New Fashion Diva
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Try high-fashion, classic, or casual looks in New Fashion Diva. Browse the clothes for each style and put together an outfit before switching to another theme.

pages.title: Domino Multiplayer
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Play matching dominoes in Domino Multiplayer. Choose a tile that fits an open end and compete online, against the computer, or with a friend on the same device.

pages.title: Llama Spitter
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Keep a llama bouncing in Llama Spitter. Watch the approaching spikes and time your moves to stay clear of them as long as you can.

pages.title: Sweet Hit
pages.creator: Pupgam Studios
pages.description: Aim and throw candy in Sweet Hit. Drag to set strength and direction, try for three stars on each level, and use power-ups when a setup gets difficult.

pages.title: Boho Vs Hipster
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Compare two wardrobe styles in Boho Vs Hipster. Try bohemian pieces and hipster outfits on the same character, then see which look you like for the season.

pages.title: Castle Defense Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fire at approaching enemies in Castle Defense Online before they reach the castle. Earn stars from the defense and spend them on power-ups or stronger weapons.

pages.title: Snakes and Ladders
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Race around the board in Snakes and Ladders. Move according to the dice and see where ladders and snakes take you. Try the five modes and compete for rewards.

pages.title: Clash of Vikings
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Deploy heroes from battle cards in Clash of Vikings. Choose a combination that fits your plan and try to defeat the opposing kingdom within three minutes.

pages.title: Baby Animal Cookies
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Bake cookies shaped like young animals in Baby Animal Cookies. Follow the preparation steps in order and work through the recipe to finish the batch.

pages.title: Bouncing Balls
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shoot a bubble into matching colors in Bouncing Balls. Form groups of three to remove them and look for useful angles as later levels introduce more colors.

pages.title: Cube Frenzy
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Guide a cube through obstacles in Cube Frenzy. Watch the route just ahead and time your movements to get through the openings as they arrive.

pages.title: Princess Black Friday
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Shop with Elsa, Moana, and Sleeping Beauty in Princess Black Friday. Grab sale items quickly and see which princess collects the most pieces for her wardrobe.

pages.title: Monster Foot Doctor
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Treat four injured ghouls in Monster Foot Doctor. Use the tools to work through each foot injury after their barefoot Halloween outing and help them finish their appointments.

pages.title: Sery Date Night Dolly Dress Up
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Open wardrobe boxes in Sery Date Night Dolly Dress Up. Pair clothes with a romantic hairstyle and finish the date-night look with bracelets or necklaces.
